Chapter 460 - 460 Rejoice; Reason! (1)

Chapter 460 - 460 Rejoice; Reason! (1)

460 Rejoice; Reason! (1)

Lin Fan nodded his head and said to Ye Xiu and the hundreds of chairmen, “Let’s go.”

“Yes, Sir!” Ye Xiu and the others said respectfully.

Then, they retreated to two sides, like lowly servants who were deliberately making way for their master.

This scene…

Everyone, including Vice-Chancellor Feng Weijian, was stunned once again.

Previously, everyone understood that the reason why these chairmen were here was because of Lin Fan.

Even so, no one had expected that Lin Fan would get hundreds of chairmen to free up a quota of 1,000 jobs with an annual salary of one million.

Now, the chairmen of these companies were even retreating to the side like servants.

This…

This…

What was the identity of this young man?

However, Lin Fan did not walk forward immediately. Instead, he looked at Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran, who were sitting not far away.

This glance caused Zheng Cong’s and Wang Haoran’s faces to flush red.

From the beginning, Lin Fan had been with Hu Tian.

Jst now… he did not ask anyone else but Hu Tian to go to the hotel with him.

In addition, Hu Tian looked at Lin Fan with affection.

Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran understood that Lin Fan and Hu Tian had probably gotten together a long time ago.

Yet they actually had feelings for Hu Tian just now.

They even talked about their positions, salaries, and power.

How could they boast about their positions, salaries, and power in front of a person who could easily get the chairmen of hundreds of giant companies to come up with 100,000 jobs, all with an annual salary of one million yuan?

How could they boast about their positions, salaries, and power in front of a man who made hundreds of chairmen give way to him like servants?

What a joke!

At this moment, Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran were both frightened and embarrassed. They wished they could find a hole in the ground and hide in it.

If Lin Fan was unhappy with him and curled his finger, their entire lives would be over.

Lin Fan did not continue to pay attention to the two of them. He walked out with Hu Tian under everyone’s gaze.

Ye Xiu and the hundreds of chairmen followed closely behind.

After they left, the entire lecture hall became empty again.

The representatives of the various companies who had gone on stage to give their speeches were still stunned and surprised.

Everyone was still shocked by the arrival of those chairmen, as well as their respectful treatment of a young man.

In contrast to the shock of the company representatives, Vice-Chancellor Feng Weijian was filled with joy.

His entire face was already wrinkled like a crumpled cloth.

He could imagine how sensational it would be when these jobs were announced. Just how much benefits would this bring to Jiangbei University?

Feng Weijian said happily, “Today’s conference is over. On behalf of all the teachers and students of Jiangbei University, I’d like to thank everyone for coming. I still have some things to deal with, so I’ll take my leave first.”

After saying that, he prepared to walk out.

He wanted to tell the chancellor the good news as soon as possible.

At this moment, someone could not help but ask, “May I ask who’s that person just now?”

Everyone’s ears perked up.

Obviously, they were also very curious about this.

“He’s Professor Lin Fan from Jiangbei University!” Feng Weijian said.

Professor Lin Fan!

Everyone felt as if they had been struck by lightning.

In the entire world, there were many people called Lin Fan.

However, Lin Fan was only in his 20s and was a professor at Jiangbei University.

He could only be one person!

He was the super genius who had solved several unsolved mathematical problems, invented the earthquake prediction device, super battery, human islet recovery drug, carbon-based photolithographic machine, advanced prosthetic limbs, and other high-tech products!

Then, everyone gradually revealed a look of realization.

No wonder so many chairmen of giant companies were so polite to him.

He was Lin Fan!

Zheng Cong’s and Wang Haoran’s faces turned even redder.

…

Lin Fan, Hu Tian, Ye Xiu, and hundreds of chairmen quickly arrived at the most luxurious hotel in Jiangbei, the Imperial Hotel.

The chairman of the Imperial Hotel, Wang Fengyi, had already received news that many important figures were coming.

Therefore, he had been waiting at the door for a long time.

When he saw Lin Fan walking at the very front and those important figures following behind him like servants, he was slightly stunned.

It was Lin Fan who spoke first. “Is the banquet hall ready?”

Only then did Wang Fengyi react and hurriedly say, “It’s all arranged. This way, please…”

Back then, Lin Fan had directly bought the Imperial Hotel. After that, he casually took out a few hundred million yuan to hold a concert. Wang Fengyi knew that his boss, Lin Fan, was definitely a big shot.

Only now did Wang Fengyi have a deeper understanding of Lin Fan’s identity.

How could this be summarized by the words ‘big shot’?

There were hundreds of big shots following behind him like underlings!

Soon, Lin Fan, Hu Tian, Ye Xiu, and the others arrived at the luxurious banquet hall on the 68th floor.
